dedupe_keys.name: dutch antenneregister rdi and antennekaart nl mobile radio link gsm r and other transmitter sites in the netherlands

description: The Antenneregister is the Dutch government's public register of antenna installations, kept by the Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI), the national inspectorate for digital infrastructure, and shown in its online viewer. Antennekaart.nl, a volunteer site running since 2019, takes all its data from the Antenneregister, processes register changes automatically and adds further processing, and publishes maps of the masts of the commercial networks of KPN, Odido and Vodafone: 5G including test sites, 4G, 3G and 2G, microwave radio links for sites without fibre or for company links, GSM-R masts of ProRail for railway communications, CDMA masts used to read smart meters, and a European air-to-ground 4G network. It also collects cell data shared anonymously by users of the NetMonster app and maintains a frequency overview. Coverage: the Netherlands. Format and access: the RDI viewer and the Antennekaart maps are free to view; bulk data access from RDI was not found in this session. Caveats: the RDI viewer is a script application that could not be read automatically, so register fields, thresholds and update frequency are from recall; Antennekaart adds its own interpretation and has its own terms of use. Simulation uses: locating mobile, railway and smart-meter communication sites for flood and power-outage exposure, and linking masts to the rail network through GSM-R. Related records: the ProRail rail network data describe the railway, and the Danish Mastedatabasen and ComReg Siteviewer are comparable registers.
licence: Not stated (Antennekaart.nl has its own terms of use)
